# General data preparation
#### Read in the data
```{r reading the data}

gfp_mg_cocul_d15 <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X("/links/groups/treutlein/DATA/sequencing/20240606_P2808_MARINA_SALL1_microglia_coculture_d15_d30/processed_with_Hygro_ref/GFP_MGcoculture_d15/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/"), project = "GFP_MG_COCUL_D15")
gfp_mg_cocul_d29 <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X("/links/groups/treutlein/DATA/sequencing/20240606_P2808_MARINA_SALL1_microglia_coculture_d15_d30/processed_with_Hygro_ref/GFP_MGcoculture_d29/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/"), project = "GFP_MG_COCUL_D29")
sall1_mg_cocul_d15 <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X("/links/groups/treutlein/DATA/sequencing/20240606_P2808_MARINA_SALL1_microglia_coculture_d15_d30/processed_with_Hygro_ref/SALL1_MGcoculture_d15/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/"), project = "SALL1_MG_COCUL_D15")
sall1_mg_cocul_d29 <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X("/links/groups/treutlein/DATA/sequencing/20240606_P2808_MARINA_SALL1_microglia_coculture_d15_d30/processed_with_Hygro_ref/SALL1_MGcoculture_d29/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/"), project = "SALL1_MG_COCUL_D29")

```

```{r create a merged object}

srt_obj_list <- list(gfp_mg_cocul_d15, gfp_mg_cocul_d29, sall1_mg_cocul_d15, sall1_mg_cocul_d29)
srt_obj_list <- lapply(X = srt_obj_list, FUN = function(x) {
    x <- NormalizeData(x)
    x <- PercentageFeatureSet(x, "^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")
})


merged <- merge(x = srt_obj_list[[1]], y = srt_obj_list[-1])

```

#### QC and integration
```{r check QC pre-filtering}

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
sall1_levels <- factor(c("GFP_MG_COCUL_D15", "GFP_MG_COCUL_D29", "SALL1_MG_COCUL_D15", "SALL1_MG_COCUL_D29"))
merged$orig.ident <- factor(merged$orig.ident, levels = sall1_levels)
Idents(merged) <- "orig.ident"
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
sall1_col <-setNames(c(c("#E69000", "#d64b0f", "#99cfc9","#026D7D")), sall1_levels)

pdf("Plots/nFeature_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/nCount_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nCount_RNA"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/percent.mt_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("percent.mt"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

```

```{r filter cells and filtering}

# subset cells based on QC metrics
merged <- subset(merged, subset =  nFeature_RNA > 700 & percent.mt < 30)

```

```{r check QC post-filtering}

pdf("Plots/nFeature_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/nCount_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nCount_RNA"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/percent.mt_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("percent.mt"), cols = sall1_col, split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()

```

```{r pre-process and integrate}

seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(merged, nfeatures = 5000) %>%
  CellCycleScoring(g2m.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes, s.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes)
blacklist <- c(unlist(cc.genes.updated.2019), grep("^MT-", rownames(seurat), value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
VariableFeatures(seurat) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat), blacklist)
seurat <- ScaleData(seurat) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 30, verbose=F) 

seurat <- cluster_sim_spectrum(seurat, label_tag="orig.ident", cluster_resolution = 1)
seurat <- RunUMAP(seurat, reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(seurat,"css")), reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_", seed = 46)

seurat <- FindNeighbors(seurat, reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(seurat,"css"))) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.2) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.3) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.4) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.6) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.8) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 10)

```

#### Subset based on vector decetion

```{r add more metadata}

Idents(seurat)<-"orig.ident"
seurat$condition <- seurat$orig.ident
seurat$condition <- gsub("GFP_MG_COCUL_D15", "control", seurat$condition)
seurat$condition <- gsub("GFP_MG_COCUL_D29", "control", seurat$condition)
seurat$condition <- gsub("SALL1_MG_COCUL_D15", "OE", seurat$condition)
seurat$condition <- gsub("SALL1_MG_COCUL_D29", "OE", seurat$condition)
seurat$timepoint <- seurat$orig.ident
seurat$timepoint <- gsub("GFP_MG_COCUL_D15", "D15", seurat$timepoint)
seurat$timepoint <- gsub("GFP_MG_COCUL_D29", "D29", seurat$timepoint)
seurat$timepoint <- gsub("SALL1_MG_COCUL_D15", "D15", seurat$timepoint)
seurat$timepoint <- gsub("SALL1_MG_COCUL_D29", "D29", seurat$timepoint)

table(seurat$condition)
# control      OE 
#   17298    16705 

table(seurat$timepoint)
#  D15   D29 
# 8372 25631 

table(seurat$timepoint, seurat$condition)
#       control    OE
#  D15    4543  3829
#  D29   12755 12876

DimPlot(seurat, reduction = "umap_css", group.by = "orig.ident", split.by = "orig.ident")
FeaturePlot(seurat, reduction = "umap_css", features = c("percent.mt", "nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"), order = T)
FeaturePlot(seurat, reduction = "umap_css", features = c("SALL1"), order = T, split.by = "orig.ident")
DotPlot(seurat, features = c("SALL1"))

```
